construct_loader_train: construct a data loader for training with shuffle and drop_last enabled from config
construct_loader_val: construct a data loader for validation with shuffle disabled from config
detection_collate_batch: collate a detection batch by concatenating bboxes labels and metadata across samples
shuffle_dataset_epoch: shuffle the dataset by setting the current epoch on the distributed sampler
construct_loader_multigrid: construct a data loader with ShortCycleBatchSampler for multigrid training
